title: 夜班的椅子

lines.text: 公司从浙江台州的一家工厂订了两万把塑料椅子，卖给南非的一家连锁超市。
lines.py: gōng sī cóng zhè jiāng tāi zhōu de yì jiā gōng chǎng dìng le liǎng wàn bǎ sù liào yǐ zi, mài gěi nán fēi de yì jiā lián suǒ chāo shì.
lines.en: The company has ordered twenty thousand plastic chairs from a factory in Taizhou, Zhejiang, for a supermarket chain in South Africa.

lines.text: 这种椅子最大的卖点是能摞起来：二十把摞在一起，也只有一米多高，运输和摆放都特别省地方。

lines.en: The chair's big selling point is that it stacks: twenty of them stacked together are only a little over a metre high, which saves a lot of space in shipping and on the shop floor.

lines.text: 杰克赶到工厂。车间是两班倒，白班从早上八点到晚上八点，夜班从晚上八点到第二天早上八点。

lines.en: Jack hurries to the factory. The workshop runs two shifts: days from eight in the morning to eight at night, nights from eight at night to eight the next morning.
